_comment: Memory-anchor CURRENCY ATTESTATIONS (sc-22667, epic sc-22657). An anchor's currency key is normally derived at its own measurement revision (scripts/anchor-loader-closure.mjs --stamp-anchors), so a pin bump that touches the model's loader closure stales it. This repository's invalidation doctrine is two-gated: a differing closure digest is not evidence that memory behaviour changed - only a load-or-device-path change without a behaviour witness is. An entry here records, per anchor, that the closure diff from `measuredRevision` to `attestedRevision` was read file by file and is accounting-only (contract pricing, byte walkers, facts, tests, docs) or is witnessed unchanged by a re-measure on the same hardware; `--stamp-anchors` then derives that anchor's key at `attestedRevision` and copies the attestation into the store's `source.currencyAttestation`. The attestation is BOUNDED: it names one revision, `measuredRevision` must still equal the cited record's inference revision, and a later pin bump that moves the loader closure past `attestedRevision` stales the anchor again until it is re-read (a new entry) or re-captured (delete the entry). Never write one for a load-or-device-path change without a measured witness - that is the false green the currency key exists to prevent. Reviewed narrative: docs/calibration/sc-22657/anchor-currency-attestation-sc-22667.md.

attestations.why: 3cd86ba2..c6d6a4db DOES touch the Krea loader path (candle-gen-krea loader.rs / pipeline.rs / transformer/mod.rs / control*.rs, candle-gen quant/mod.rs + quant/adapt.rs, candle-gen-boogu, candle-gen-qwen-image and candle-gen-pid files the closure reaches), so the diff alone cannot classify this anchor. It is attested on a MEASURED witness instead: the E6 falsification fixture re-measured krea_2_turbo q4 at a5f643ae (22 first-parent merges after 3cd86ba2) on the same GPU and the cold staged control reproduces the packaged anchor per phase. The remaining a5f643ae..c6d6a4db range is accounting-only: gen-core lib.rs (re-export), memory_strategy.rs (contract types), weightsmeta.rs (walker hidden-cache skip) and candle-gen quant/sidecar.rs (CACHE_DIR constant re-homed, same value).
attestations.witness: docs/calibration/sc-22657/candle-five-rung-falsification-sc-22667.json krea_2_turbo q4 coldStagedControl at a5f643ae against the packaged anchor: conditioning 3.694 GB vs 3.828 (-3.5%, under), denoise 15.099 vs 15.103 (-0.02%), decode 22.349 vs 22.352 (-0.01%). The batch's resident rung (12.73 GB conditioning) also brackets the contract's 11.73 GB component total, as the E6 test asserts.

attestations.why: Every file the z_image_turbo:candle loader closure changed in 670dc1f4..c6d6a4db carries contract ACCOUNTING, not load or device behaviour: candle-gen-z-image/src/memory_strategy.rs grew the per-component asset facts, architecture facts and loaded-path pricing the sc-22657 law reads; candle-gen/src/architecture_facts.rs is a new snapshot-config reader for those facts; gen-core's memory_strategy.rs / weightsmeta.rs / wan_i2v_memory.rs carry the contract types and the tensor-free byte walkers (materialized_* readers; the .candle-device-format-v1 hidden-cache skip) that price the checkpoint without touching the loader; gen-core lib.rs and candle-gen lib.rs are re-export / `pub mod` lines for those; gen-core registry.rs and runtime.rs move a #[cfg(test)] helper and fix a Windows-only test fixture; candle-gen-pid/src/engine.rs names the f32 load dtype and merged-file constants it already used (same values, and PiD is not on the Z-Image path); candle-gen/src/quant/sidecar.rs re-homes the `.candle-device-format-v1` CACHE_DIR literal to gen-core's constant with the same value. No loader, pipeline, weights, kernel, quant or device-format code path changed.
attestations.witness: No hardware re-measure of the bf16 tier itself; the classification stands on the diff alone, which is the same file set as the q4 anchor's (the closure is per model, not per tier) and carries no load or device path change. The q4 tier's cold-staged re-measure at a5f643ae (docs/calibration/sc-22657/candle-five-rung-falsification-sc-22667.json) witnesses that the shared loader's memory behaviour did not move across the larger half of this range.
